usage: 一碗 functions as a noun phrase indicating a specific quantity or volume related to a bowl.
You can use 一碗 before a noun to specify the amount as one bowlful of that item.
It usually appears in daily conversation to measure food or liquid portions.
It is commonly followed by 食物 (food) or 湯 (soup) as the object of the quantity.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 wun2 tong1.
examples.meaning: I want one bowl of soup.
